subtitle: 기사·도적·냥꾼 몰매 뒤에 숨어있던 무분전사의 가스라이팅

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
와 성기사 또 올입찰이네!
양심 없는 기사 먼저 패자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle accusation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, scheming Orc Warrior (battle axe stowed on back) points an empty finger dramatically forward with a theatrical righteous glare and a tiny sly smirk. On the right, bewildered Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) raises both empty hands defensively sweating under sudden blame.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
필비도 성검도 다 도적 꺼!
…어 왜 다음 타겟이 나야?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile blame-shift gag shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the right, cheeky Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips and zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) holds up a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold loot die with round dot pips only (no digits), then freezes sweating as everyone turns on her. On the left, Orc Warrior (battle axe stowed on back) points sharply at Gnome Rogue with fake outrage while quietly nudging a glowing loot chest closer behind her own boot.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
아쉬칸디? 랩터 크리 좋잖아!
이건 냥꾼 대검 맞거든?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Orc Warrior (green plush orc hood and back-slung battle axe in lower-right foreground) looking at Dwarf Hunter on the left, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-right space and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, shamelessly beaming Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) reaches eagerly with both empty hands toward a gleaming dark-metallic epic greatsword resting on the stone while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf cheers raising his paws beside her.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 83 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero text or speech bubbles. Mastermind Orc Warrior (battle axe stowed away, empty hands steepled craftily beneath her chin) flashes a chillingly smug villainous smirk with half-lidded glinting crimson eyes and dark dramatic shadow lines while hoarded brown leather boots, silver interlocking ring-mesh mail gauntlets, and gleaming epic sword hilts peek out behind her red cape.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐, 가죽·사슬 다 턴 게
전부 무분전사 가스라이팅?!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle sudden epiphany shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, stunned Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) widens her golden eyes in shocked realization pointing sharply ahead with an empty hand. On the right, jaw-dropped Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) gasps in disbelief while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf covers his mouth with both paws in shock beside her.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
2005년 패턴 그대로네!
무분돼지 너부터 이리 와!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view slapstick chase finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, furious Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips and zero hairpins, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) sprints forward pointing angrily after her quarry. On the right, busted Orc Warrior (battle axe stowed on back) scrambles fleeing in panic hugging an overflowing bundle of brown leather boots, a silver interlocking ring-mesh mail-armor belt, and gleaming epic swords with giant sweat drops flying off her green plush orc hood.
